title: Funding carry shadow tracker: BTC and ETH cash-and-carry, forward only, no money
why: tools/funding_carry_study.py (report funding_carry_20260922_1913.json) measured the 'always' variant at about 6% (BTC) and 7% (ETH) a year on capital with max drawdown near 1%, declining to 2.6% in 2025 and 0.9% in 2026 so far. That is a backtest on public archive rates. This tracker only records the funding that is actually published from now on, so the number can be checked forward.
rule: Always in position: long spot plus short the same notional of the USDT perpetual. No switching, no parameters.
accounting: Return on total capital = funding rate / 2 per settlement (half the capital is spot, half is short collateral at 1x). One entry cost of 0.3% round trip x 1/2 x 1/2 of notional on capital is charged at the start; the exit cost is not charged while the position is held.
not_modelled: Basis between spot and perpetual at entry and exit, margin top-ups, exchange risk, borrow or withdrawal costs. The tracker is an upper bound on what a real position would earn.

verdict_rule.GO_SMALL: after at least 84 days, net return on capital after the entry cost is above 0 and the annualised pace is at least 2%
verdict_rule.BRAKE: at any time, if the live max drawdown on capital exceeds 3% (three times the worst backtest drawdown)

authority: Never places an order, never touches gates.json, never read by the autotrader.
